options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380.

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: catalog
options.description: Catalog zone name to register as its member zone (Primary, Stub, Forwarder only)

options.name: disabled
options.description: Sets if the zone is enabled or disabled

options.name: node
options.description: The node domain name for which this API call is intended When unspecified, the current node is used This parameter can be used only when Clustering is initialized

options.name: notify
options.description: Notify policy

options.name: notifyNameServers
options.description: List of IPs to notify (Primary, Secondary, Forwarder, Catalog only)

options.name: notifySecondaryCatalogsNameServers
options.description: List of IPs to notify for catalog updates (Catalog only)

options.name: overrideCatalogNotify
options.description: Override Notify option in the Catalog zone (Primary, Forwarder only)

options.name: overrideCatalogQueryAccess
options.description: Override Query Access option in the Catalog zone (Primary, Stub, Forwarder only)

options.name: overrideCatalogZoneTransfer
options.description: Override Zone Transfer option in the Catalog zone (Primary, Forwarder only)

options.name: primaryNameServerAddresses
options.description: List of IPs or names of the primary name server (Secondary, SecondaryForwarder, SecondaryCatalog, Stub only)

options.name: primaryZoneTransferProtocol
options.description: Zone transfer protocol (Secondary, SecondaryForwarder, SecondaryCatalog only)

options.name: primaryZoneTransferTsigKeyName
options.description: TSIG key name for zone transfer (Secondary, SecondaryForwarder, SecondaryCatalog only)

options.name: queryAccess
options.description: Query access policy

options.name: queryAccessNetworkACL
options.description: List of network ACL entries for query access (not SecondaryCatalog, only with certain queryAccess set)

options.name: update
options.description: Allow dynamic updates

options.name: updateNetworkACL
options.description: List of network ACL entries for update (Primary, Secondary, Forwarder, with certain update set)

options.name: updateSecurityPolicies
options.description: List of security policies for zone updates (Primary, Forwarder only)

options.name: validateZone
options.description: Enable ZONEMD validation (Secondary only).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.

options.name: zone
options.description: The domain name of the zone to set options for.

options.name: zoneTransfer
options.description: Zone transfer policy (Primary, Secondary only)

options.name: zoneTransferNetworkACL
options.description: List of network ACL entries for zone transfer (Primary, Secondary, Forwarder, Catalog only, with certain zoneTransfer set)

options.name: zoneTransferTsigKeyNames
options.description: List of TSIG key names for zone transfer (Primary, Secondary, Forwarder, Catalog only)
